description: Get a link to a page for one task, to give the user: connect, reconnect or disconnect a LinkedIn account (they sign in on a secure page that handles every LinkedIn check), create an API key, add a webhook, or set up their own white-label brand. Send action: connect, reconnect, disconnect, key, webhook or brand, plus account_id to reconnect or disconnect. A password, a new key, a signing secret or a payment key stays on that page and never comes back through the chat. The link lasts an hour. Check the outcome with GET /linkedin/connect/link/{handle}. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /linkedin/connect/link, group connect.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
